name: PCD Network Director
tagline: Per-tenant gateways with firewall, NAT and VPN.
description: A management plane for gateway appliances on PCD. Every tenant gets a hardened VyOS gateway with firewall, NAT, port forwarding and WireGuard VPN. Optional provider gateways add a shared BGP/ECMP tier for routable tenant networks.
includes: One gateway VM per OpenStack project
Firewall, NAT, DNAT and WireGuard in one UI
Provider tier with BGP and ECMP

configuration.label: Keystone auth URL
configuration.help: Pre-fills first-run setup. Network Director signs in to PCD with this endpoint.

configuration.label: Service project
configuration.help: Project Network Director authenticates against. The signing-in user needs the admin role here.

configuration.label: Gateway WAN network
configuration.help: Uplink for tenant gateways; port security must be off.

configuration.label: Gateway management CIDR
configuration.help: Subnet for gw-mgmt-net, created by Network Director.

post_deploy_notes: Open the web UI. First-run setup is pre-filled from this form; review it, save, then sign in with a PCD user that has the admin role in the service project. SSH is key-only as user alpine.
